entries.title: Revelation of John 8:1
segments: ¶When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:2
segments: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and to them were given seven trumpets.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:3
segments: Then another angel, having a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense, that he should offer [it] with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:4
segments: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, ascended before God from the angel's hand.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:5
segments: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw [it] to the earth. And there were noises, thunderings, lightnings, and an earthquake.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:6
segments: So the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:7
segments: ¶The first angel sounded: And hail and fire followed, mingled with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:8
segments: Then the second angel sounded: And [something] like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:9
segments: And a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:10
segments: Then the third angel sounded: And a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:11
segments: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many men died from the water, because it was made bitter.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:12
segments: Then the fourth angel sounded: And a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them were darkened. A third of the day did not shine, and likewise the night.

entries.title: Revelation of John 8:13
segments: And I looked, and I heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, "Woe, woe, woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!"
